responsibility: This header declares the option-state API exported from the Modula-2 options module to the C/C++ tree-building code. It covers language dialect selection, runtime and safety checks, preprocessing and search-path settings, debug and dump controls, save-temps and dependency options, module scaffolding choices, forced source-location handling, and retrieval of derived option values, making it the primary interface through which gm2 backend-facing code queries frontend option semantics.
